title: ACL-Federated-Load-Twin: reference implementation for cost-optimal asymmetric conformal calibration for degraded federated load forecasting
description:
Reference implementation and derived dataset for an Adaptive Conformal Layer (ACL) applied to federated load forecasting under telemetry degradation.

A fleet of 60 buildings trains one federated forecaster. Each building re-sizes its prediction interval daily from realized errors, scoring signed residuals so the upper and lower radii are set independently. The cost-optimal coverage target is either set in closed form by a newsvendor rule when reserve costs are published, or learned online by a two-segment UCB bandit from daily settlement bills when they are not. The deployment stage runs as a digital twin at two fidelities: a single-process simulator, and a production mirror in which meters publish daily batches over MQTT into a keyed Kafka log consumed by a stateful ACL processor.
